title: Glasshouse Roller
prompt: drum n bass meets aphex twin with ambient intros
description: A long beatless ambient opening of breathing pads and far-off square arps slowly resolves into a rolling, melody-led liquid drum and bass break. Filters bloom open, the AkaiLinn break tightens and dries out, and a dreamy phrygian arp carries the tune over delay tails before everything dissolves back into haze.
